Ketoconazole was as- sociated with a significant increase in plasma-carbamazepine concentrations in 8 epileptic patients stabilised on car- bamazepine;2 plasma concentrations of the epoxide metabolite were unchanged. A threefold increase in serum-carbamazepine concentrations, reported3 in a patient after addition of flucona- zole to carbamazepine therapy, was asymptomatic; however, car- bamazepine toxicity has been reported4,5 in 2 patients stabilised on carbamazepine who were given fluconazole.
